messages:
maria: quick async standup — deployed small rate-limit tweak to api-gw canary (route: /v2/generate). saw a few 429s during burst tests at 1200rps, pushed a temporary higher burst window. no user-facing errors yet.
kevin: noted. do you have the logs for the 429s? can we narrow to a policy or upstream?
sana: pinging about config — is this the policy in rlate-policy-2? i can pair on a smaller token-based quota if needed.
maria: logs: https://logs.internal/redwood/ingress/1768 — main pattern is `rate_policy: token_bucket` tripping after ~800ms into the test, then 50-100ms tail latency spikes. looks like batching pressure + small token refill.
lee: minor thought — we just rolled kernel update on canary nodes yesterday. could be perf cliff causing slower request processing => tokens consumed but not refilled. worth checking node cpu steal and nvlink stats.
maria: good call. i checked node metrics: cpu steady, but a subset of pods showed higher p95 GPU util (likely packing). i've reverted that deployment to previous image for now.
jamal: PR for the config change? i'll review. also, can we add a fallback routing rule to route-exec to lower-cost model for canary when 429 rate > 5%? small A/B to validate.
maria: opened PR #1423: https://git.internal/redwood/eng-platform/pulls/1423 — small change under gateway/rate_policies: added burst=350, refill=70 and fallback route to model-lite when 429_ratio >= 0.05.
kevin: on it. quick review comment: consider isolating the token bucket keys per customer to avoid head-of-line blocking — added suggestion.
sana: if anyone's free, can we pair to test the token refill math? i can simulate with `wrk` and the script i used last time.
lee: free in 20m. ping me and we can run the script against the canary.
deploy-bot: deploy started for canary/gateway:v2026-rollback at 1768881280 — watch: https://deploys.internal/redwood/canary/1768881280
maria: thanks — i'll run a short smoke now, will report back. blocker: need approval on the fallback route naming, would prefer `model-fallback-lite` vs `model-lite` to be explicit.
jamal: approve the name `model-fallback-lite`. go ahead. :thumbsup:
maria: smoke done — 5-minute burst at 1500rps. 429s dropped from 3.8% => 0.9% after tweak + rollback. will keep monitoring and schedule a follow-up pairing to iterate on token sizing.
kevin: looks good. can you add a tiny note in the incident playbook about this class of 429s (batching + kernel perf)? saved a few folks later. link it under /runbooks/gateway-429s.
maria: done, added short note and reproducer snippet: ```bash
# reproducer
wrk -t8 -c400 -d60s https://canary.api.redwood/v2/generate -s scripts/generate_workload.lua
```
sana: cool, thanks. i'll review PR in a bit and help add a unit test for the policy matcher.
lee: one more: add a metric for `fallback_route_triggered` so we can graph before/after. small follow-up task.
maria: added ticket in backlog: PLAT-537 (metric + dashboard). marking this resolved for today unless new regressions show up. thanks team!
